summary: Dolores County, CO tower built 1941 in San Juan NF; taken down 1970 and replaced that year by nearby Benchmark Lookout; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Taken down in 1970; Benchmark Lookout was built the same year to replace it. No source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Taken down in 1970 (FFLOS detail page); listed as Removed on the Forest Lookouts page
Replaced by Benchmark Lookout, a 42-foot wooden tower built in 1970 to replace Glade Mountain Lookout

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLOS detail page gives N 37.775690 W 108.587670 and the FFLOS state list gives 37.77611, -108.58806 for the same site. The two differ slightly; the story reports both and the research keeps the detail-page value.

notes_for_editor: Sources are short register entries. None gives design, height, staffing, fires or site condition, so the story omits them. Nothing found describes the Glade site today. The NHLR Benchmark page (as of 2019) mentions a locked gate installed after vandalism; that belongs to Benchmark's own record. Search budget was exceeded by one websearch.py call (three used). A Forest Fire Lookout Association Facebook post about a 1941 Glade photo was not in the cache and was not read.
